scope: Only local namespace predicate patch and recorded actual regression/full SDK output. Read-only review; no source edits, test rerun, wallet, RPC or deployment.

exact_patch_proof.implication: The source bytes differ only by this single predicate expression; ABI/state machine/content hash logic are unchanged.

observations: Regex first checks the exact allowed host/40-hex locator and ASCII shape, then all components after the hostname are checked via split('/')[3:], rejecting dot-only repository as well as dot file paths.
For CorroborationSignal the publisher capture remains match[1]; no capture-group meaning changes.
Raw and existing supported gist URL shapes remain otherwise unchanged; exact byte SHA verification is retained.
Each pair of actual public-API dot-repository regressions failed on old local source then passed in the current full suite.
old_review_status: Any old full-source review corresponds to the previous source hash and is historical. This narrow addendum reviews the local fix only, not a new complete audit.
limits: Local correction is not applied to the recorded onchain contract or public repository. No content-integrity bypass or live exploit is claimed.
